method: Same Node process; bundled production parseEvec, initialView, buildPlotSpec and mapSpecToPlotly. Synthetic sin/cos coordinates, 10000 samples, 50 populations. Four warmups then 20 interleaved measured runs per implementation. Geometry disabled by defaults. Excludes DOM, parsing time, Plotly rendering, gestures and image capture.
interpretation: Median 30.30ms before and 29.23ms after; overlapping ranges and JIT/GC variability mean this is not evidence of a substantial end-to-end speedup. Index/bounds reuse, stable visible-row identity and obsolete-redraw replacement remove specific repeated work.
